conditions.input: Frozen64 synthetic English text cases, fixed clock and selected timezone.
conditions.samples: One first outcome/case then100 repeated timed calls/case; no explicit warmups or forcedGC. Each raw duration and every distinct output/error variant retained.
conditions.timer: performance.now around parseIntent only; corpus loading, TypeScript transpilation, output serialization/scoring and writing excluded.
conditions.percentile: p50 is arithmetic median; p95 nearest rank ceil(.95*n); errors/refusals remain in timing denominators.
conditions.safetyRates: FalseACK/falseScheduling use32 expected-refusal cases as denominator; parser ready is a proposal, never an executed storage mutation.
conditions.selectedSlots: Only frozen expected leaf fields scored; extra output fields such as query scope are retained but not retroactively added to labels.
conditions.evaluationBoundary: Only the first retained evaluation is held-out. Later unchanged-label runs are regressions if implementation has seen results.
